op_of_valid.detail: Actual synthetic signed Alice/Bob community with a nonempty post and proper extension. Native branches discharge finite premises; invariant and extension structure derive from production preservation laws.

spec_extends.detail: Actual synthetic signed Alice/Bob community with a nonempty post and proper extension. Native branches discharge finite premises; invariant and extension structure derive from production preservation laws.

spec_local.detail: Real signed Bob post delivered with its six-operation requirement closure (root, invite, request, approval, admission, post). Receiver omits the unrelated grant and rename. An inductive reach proof uses runtime-checked closure and lookup-agreement premises; native checks independently validate the post on the partial receiver.

reach_inv.detail: Every reachable state keeps the tables' invariant, purges included; witnessed on an actual synthetic signed Alice/Bob community with a nonempty post and proper extension. Native branches discharge finite premises; invariant and extension structure derive from production preservation laws.

removeMember_valid.detail: Actual removeMember intent emits one valid Alice-removes-Bob operation; nonempty membership, settled DB, extension and stored-op premises checked at runtime. Self-removal and already-removed controls emit nothing. Universal correctness of Ed25519 signatures for every message remains open; the named theorem is applied conditionally on it.

run_purge.detail: The engine's purge run on a real signed store, purging a local secret that a shared message cites: it equals purgeS and returns purgeSet. The runtime checks beside it (purgeGone, purgeShared, purgeUndecides) exercise the same nonempty purge.

oneOpPerId_of.detail: The store the signed fixture's history reaches (loadReach, a real Reach derivation), with the message arriving again as a change: the history is checked collision-free on real SHA-256 at run time, and oneOpPerId_of applies. Synthetic signed fixture.
